title: Everything Is Fine
subtitle: Newly-deceased Eleanor Shellstrop is sent to the Good Place but only by mistake; Eleanor is determined to become a better person in her afterlife with help from fellow dead person Chidi and not-a-robot Janet.

title: Flying
subtitle: Eleanor tries to prove to Chidi that she's worthy of his help; Tahani and Jianyu try to help Michael cope with a mysterious flaw in his neighborhood.

title: Tahani Al-Jamil
subtitle: Chidi starts giving Eleanor formal lessons in ethics -- the first lesson is to be kind to your neighbor; Michael and Janet assist Chidi in finding a new hobby.

title: Jason Mendoza
subtitle: Eleanor has a hard time remaining hidden; Michael asks Tahani to assist a neighbor in finding her true purpose.

title: Category 55 Emergency Doomsday Crisis
subtitle: Teaching Eleanor about ethics becomes a full-time job for Chidi; Michael and Janet must deal with an emergency.

title: What We Owe to Each Other
subtitle: Eleanor is enlisted to help Michael with an important task that could determine her fate in the Good Place. Meanwhile, Chidi agrees to be the third wheel in an effort to help out his friend.

title: The Eternal Shriek
subtitle: Eleanor and Chidi find that the only way to save Michael from going to the Bad Place is to deactivate Janet. Since she is programmed to answer any question, Janet tells them exactly how to do it.

title: Most Improved Player
subtitle: Michael has a private meeting with Eleanor. Meanwhile, Chidi, who has been harboring a secret, contemplates what to do.

title: ...Someone Like Me as a Member
subtitle: Michael's skills are put to the test when he attempts to sort out an unprecedented situation. Meanwhile, Chidi makes a connection elsewhere, much to the dismay of Eleanor, while Janet shows a different side of herself.

title: Chidi's Choice
subtitle: Michael tasks Chidi with making an important decision, while Eleanor makes a personal discovery and Jianyu makes a big announcement.

title: What's My Motivation
subtitle: Eleanor and Tahani hatch a plan as Michael makes a surprising discovery. Chidi confides in Eleanor when he learns some interesting news.

title: Mindy St. Claire
subtitle: Chidi and Tahani help Michael as he faces his first biggest challenge yet; Eleanor, Jianyu and Janet face a huge decision; Eleanor and her friends think about their fates.

title: Michael's Gambit
subtitle: Shawn has decided that Fake Eleanor, Chidi, Jason and Tahani must decide among themselves in thirty minutes which two of them should go to The Bad Place. Chaos and confusion ensues.

title: Everything Is Great!
subtitle: After Michael erases their memories, Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason find themselves in the Good Place again, but Eleanor finds a clue she left for herself and tries to put everything together.

title: Dance Dance Resolution
subtitle: Michael continues working out the kinks in his plan and Eleanor discovers a secret.

title: Team Cockroach
subtitle: Michael looks at things from a different angle as Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani, and Jason try to make a collective decision.

title: Existential Crisis
subtitle: Michael experiences an existential crisis; Tahani throws a dinner party; Eleanor reflects on her childhood.

title: The Trolley Problem
subtitle: Chidi and Eleanor tackle a famous ethical dilemma, leading to a conflict with Michael; Tahani confides in Janet.

title: Janet and Michael
subtitle: When the neighborhood experiences a small glitch, Michael has to resolve the issue with Janet before it gets out of control.

title: Derek
subtitle: Janet creates a problem for Michael; Tahani and Jason plan a wedding; Eleanor reveals a secret to Chidi.

title: Leap to Faith
subtitle: Michael gets a surprise visitor; Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason try to solve a riddle.

title: Best Self
subtitle: Michael gets into a bind; Eleanor has an idea that leads Chidi, Tahani, Jason, and even Janet to put their feelings on the line.

title: Rhonda, Diana, Jake, and Trent
subtitle: Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani, Janet and Jason go to a place with potentially lasting implications.

title: The Burrito
subtitle: Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason consider how much they have (or haven't) improved; Michael must deal with the consequences of his recent actions.

title: Somewhere Else
subtitle: Janet and Chidi reveal some unexpressed emotions. Michael pushes for a new kind of experiment.

title: Everything Is Bonzer!
subtitle: Michael prevents the deaths of Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason, hoping a second chance at life will allow them to become better people.

title: The Brainy Bunch
subtitle: Michael is forced to take drastic measures when his grand scheme hits a snag.

title: The Snowplow
subtitle: An announcement from someone in the group threatens to tear them apart.

title: Jeremy Bearimy
subtitle: The group explores the three main branches of ethical thought.

title: The Ballad of Donkey Doug
subtitle: Jason visits with some people from his past, while Chidi gets help in resolving a problem.

title: A Fractured Inheritance
subtitle: Eleanor makes a startling discovery that tests her resolve, Tahani looks to make amends and Janet does some bonding.

title: The Worst Possible Use of Free Will
subtitle: Eleanor recalls some forgotten events from her past.

title: Don't Let the Good Life Pass You By
subtitle: Michael and Janet take an important journey. Eleanor ponders whether she should share a secret.

title: Janet(s)
subtitle: Michael and Janet go on a quest to help the four humans. Eleanor and Chidi have a philosophical disagreement about their relationship.

title: The Book of Dougs
subtitle: Michael's resolve is put to the test. Meanwhile, Jason wrestles with his feelings and Chidi surprises Eleanor.

title: Chidi Sees the Time-Knife
subtitle: Eleanor and the gang meet the judge at the crossroads of all dimensions, time and space to plead their case and Janet makes a reconnection.

title: Pandemonium
subtitle: Eleanor steps in to help when Michael panics. Tahani faces a new kind of torment. Eleanor and Chidi come to an unexpected crossroad.

title: A Girl from Arizona
subtitle: With Eleanor assuming the role of the architect, the group adapts to the challenges facing them when four test subjects inhabit a new neighborhood under their supervision.

title: A Girl from Arizona Part 2
subtitle: Eleanor, Michael, Janet and Tahani have their hands full when the new residents begin to show their true colors. Jason receives some unsettling news.

title: Chillaxing
subtitle: Michael and Eleanor discover something troubling and turn to an unusual source for help; Tahani lends her expertise to assist with one of the new residents.

title: Tinker, Tailor, Demon, Spy
subtitle: Uncertainty abounds when an unexpected visitor arrives.

title: Employee of the Bearimy
subtitle: Michael and Jason hatch a plan. Eleanor learns firsthand the difficulties of running the neighborhood.

title: A Chip Driver Mystery
subtitle: One of the new residents creates a division in the ranks.

title: Help Is Other People
subtitle: On the last day of the experiment, Chidi is faced with one final ethical dilemma.

title: The Funeral to End All Funerals
subtitle: The Judge hears Michael and Shawn's arguments about the results of the experiment. Janet and the humans give each other the funerals they deserved.

title: The Answer
subtitle: With time running out to find answers, Chidi must sort through his life - and afterlives - before he can provide the help everyone needs.

title: You've Changed, Man
subtitle: As the Judge keeps searching for the device to reboot the Earth in Janets' voids, the 'soul squad' tries to come up with a new afterlife system.

title: Mondays, Am I Right?
subtitle: Michael runs some tests and Chidi gets some good advice from Jason.

title: Patty
subtitle: Arriving at a new place, Michael receives an unexpected honour. Meanwhile, rest of the group explores - and learns a shocking truth.

title: Whenever You're Ready
subtitle: Michael works with the Joint Council of Afterlife Affairs to smooth out kinks in the system. Jason and Tahani move on. Eleanor tries to influence Chidi.
